acceptanceCriteria: ticket create and ticket refine with empty touchPaths and resources report an explicit whole-repository warning (or require an explicit opt-in) in the command result, with a stable code.
queue status and plan preview name tickets deferred only because of the whole-repository serial fallback.
Spec amendment with numbered proposed requirements, failing-before/passing-after focused tests, independent review and sealed change evidence; GitHub #679 closed by the merged PR.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#679. ticket create accepts effects.touchPaths=[] with no resources; the planner then falls back to serialFallback WHOLE_REPOSITORY and the ticket stays DEFERRED/RESOURCE_COLLISION behind every live attempt with no warning at create time or in queue status. Observed in an adopter queue on 2026-10-08: a P0 ticket was deferred until ticket set-effects added four touchPaths. Proposal: warn (EFFECTS_UNBOUNDED) or require an explicit whole-repository opt-in on create/refine; list fallback-only deferrals in queue status / plan preview; optionally --effects-from <ticket>.
